name: view-receipt-card
title: View receipt card
description: A receipt of what a person was shown: component, record, who, when and the hash of the data drawn, with a verdict only from the checks you pass in.

files.content:
import { judgeView, type ViewReceiptRow } from './viewreceipt' import { cx, formatWhen } from './util' export type ViewReceiptCardProps = ViewReceiptRow & { title?: string; className?: string } /** * One receipt of what a person was shown: which component, which record, to whom, when, and the hash of the data drawn. * The verdict comes from the checks you pass in, so a receipt that nobody checked reads as "Not checked". */ export function ViewReceiptCard({ receipt, signatureValid, dataMatches, title = 'Shown to reviewer', className }: ViewReceiptCardProps) { const v = judgeView({ receipt, signatureValid, dataMatches }) return (

{title}

{v.word}

{v.text}

Component
{receipt.component}
Record
{receipt.kind}/{receipt.source}
Shown to
{receipt.by}
When
{formatWhen(receipt.shownAt)}
Data hash
{receipt.dataHash.slice(0, 12)}
{receipt.planHash && <>
Plan hash
{receipt.planHash.slice(0, 12)}
}
) }
